artifact_purpose: Current primary AI field-mapping review, authorized directly by the user; factual inventory retained for traceability.

source_files: available source code, evidence, fixtures, and frozen official Parquet samples

inventory_summary.meaning_boundary: Crosswalk status and historical live-check evidence are not C65 field/unit/business-key signoff. C65 package states human review is pending and leaves signature conclusions blank.

crosswalk_scope_and_status.fact: Crosswalk contains 34 provider/domain rows; THS financial_indicator is pending and excluded, leaving 33 active rows. Status labels are crosswalk capability states.

field_mapping_inventory_and_manual_revie.fact: Two mapping YAMLs contain 10 source/domain maps; C65 package states waiting for cloudQuant human review and does not sign off.

akshare_mapping_yaml.fact: Contains stock_daily, index_constituent, financial_statement, financial_indicator mappings.

ths_mapping_yaml.fact: Contains stock_daily, stock_action, index_daily, futures_daily, option_daily, financial_statement mappings.

macro_contract.fact: MacroSeries contract is a narrow series_id/date/value shape; this review did not find per-provider field/unit maps in the two mapping YAMLs.

ths_daily_parquet.date_ms_semantics: Official docs say Asia/Shanghai midnight; volume is shares; turnover is original currency; A-share sample currency is CNY.
ths_daily_parquet.raw_to_prepared_fact: Raw parquet has date_ms, not trade_date. dump_import.prepare_daily_k_frame derives trade_date from date_ms. normalize_frame requires declared source columns already present; ms_column is used by reverse projection. REST adapter separately converts its millisecond date field.
ths_daily_parquet.boundary: This is a real official Parquet sample, not a row-level REST payload comparison or a full-market/10-year coverage proof.

duplicate_groups.classification: conflicting values: cash and bonus differ

ths_action_parquet.event_identity_fact: Available official docs/schema support thscode and ex_date_ms as key fields and ticker as display code; no supported event_type, record_date, or stable source event ID was found. ODS event_key is content-derived, not an official event identity.
ths_action_parquet.comparator_fact: Official comparison record is FAIL with duplicate_raw_keys and duplicate_parsed_keys; 57530 parsed rows, 57527 unique model keys, zero value differences.
ths_action_parquet.uniqueness_conclusion: The current candidate contract key [symbol, ex_date] is not unique on this official sample. Existing comparator fails closed on raw/parsed duplicate keys. No approved deduplication or conflict resolution policy is evidenced.

ths_action_rest_boundary.rest_adapter_behavior: Constructs cash_dividend and stock_dividend; does not map rights_shares or rights_price from REST; rights unit has not been observed.
ths_action_rest_boundary.parquet_difference: Parquet contains allotment_ratio and allotment_price; this does not establish their availability or units on REST.

fin_statement_contract.fact: Contract documents announce_date and revision as dimensions for first releases/restatements and PIT queries. Both current statement mapping business keys omit announce_date and revision. No evidence in this review establishes that the sources retain only a single version.

akshare_statement_sample.fact: Current mapping passes Chinese statement/item source vocabulary through; contract docs expect normalized statement type and item codes. Sample candidate unit is CNY and scale 1; code/item normalization remains a human review point.

akshare_indicator_sample.fact: Indicators have mixed units; unit is optional in contract but raw sample has no unit column. Mapping declares unit <- unit. Indicator codes are source passthrough; candidate business key omits announce_date and revision.

akshare_constituent_sample.fact: C65 marks ready for human review; port zfill behavior supports code-padding candidate. Source model says weight is percent and as_of is the actual CSI list date.

index_asof_semantics.fact: AkShare as_of is the date belonging to the CSI close-weight list. THS only publishes current membership with no list date and uses request observation day. C34 records quarter-reconstitution membership differences.

fred_comparison.fact: Same-publisher official FRED JSON/CSV comparison, explicitly not an independent statistical truth comparison.

yfinance_source_fact.fact: Provider documents quote-currency/share OHLCV, nullable amount, and explicit handling of dividend/split adjustments; no C65 official raw schema or row sample for Yahoo was included.

historical_aggregate_only.fact: THS index_daily (C5), futures_daily and option_daily (C6), and financial_statement (C10) have historical aggregate/cross-source evidence but no row-level raw sample in this package.

calendar_and_instrument.fact: Calendar is a trailing-year window and does not include current day; instrument catalog is a current snapshot, has no delisted A-shares, and list_date may be hollow. Neither has a field map in the two reviewed mapping YAMLs.

fund_etf_historical_fact.fact: Crosswalk cites C20 evidence that THS ETF REST returns forward-adjusted sequence and conversion uses fund_action; this is historical behavior evidence, not a current raw field/unit mapping.

fund_action_historical_fact.fact: Crosswalk cites C15 14-event comparison and states AkShare Sina fund_action shape is cumulative and differs from the contract event shape.

map_execution_layer.fact: Raw Parquet date_ms/ex_date_ms are transformed into prepared trade_date/ex_date. Direct normalize_frame requires mapped source columns to exist and does not derive dates from ms_column; denormalize_frame derives milliseconds in reverse.
